label: BRIDGE_2: beings without a limiting…: For all beings x and y, if neither has a limiting principle…
term: bridge: beings without a limiting principle share a nature
definition: For all beings x and y, if neither has a limiting principle then essence x = essence y. It ranges over all beings of the carrier and holds vacuously at every pair with a limited member.
note: Open, unattributed bridge. It concerns equality of represented nature values, not numerical identity of beings. No source statement of this universal form has been read; De ente c.3 and Compendium I.15 give an inventory of multiplication modes whose exhaustiveness is the disputed point. A source for it would have to state that every difference of nature entails one of the three disjuncts.
